findings.text: RESOLVED (prior blocking): the first review (bound to 58b042c) found the builder's exec-bit selftest assertion hard-coded st_mode == 0o755, which is umask-dependent and went gate-RED on the reviewer's umask-002 checkout (git checks an executable file out 0775 there) though the committed git mode is correctly 100755. Fixed by relaxing to the exec-bit check (st_mode & 0o111 != 0); bin/warp is byte-identical across the amend (58b042c -> a3fec2e), still committed 100755. The re-verify confirmed the fix is the sole delta and the gate is GREEN on the previously-red umask-002 machine. LESSON: selftest exec-bit checks must be umask-independent.

Spend-gate touch honest and correct: the fleet refuses to pace against a fabricated token budget (fails loud when no session/weekly windows declared) - a fleet must pace against a real budget (RULE #2/#6). Protected paths clean (the amended commit adds only scripts/selftest.py to the prior 4-file impl); RULE #1 clean.

summary: WARP-0904 (the real warp CLI, W4 of PLAN-0009) passes at a3fec2e. bin/warp is a genuinely thin, fail-loud dispatcher over the W1-W3 modules with no detached-spawn path, correct double-load account-error handling, an honest fabricated-budget refusal, and a correct committed 100755 mode; all five ACs' behaviors were confirmed by concrete probes in an isolated worktree, and the gate is GREEN with selftest 1345/0. Two non-blocking notes. Verdict: pass.
